listing.style: Contemporary (1977) — post-and-beam two-story hillside with detached ADU
listing.description: Montclair hillside retreat w/ panoramic hill views & a well-appointed ADU on nearly a third of an acre in the scenic Oakland Hills. Vaulted wood-plank ceilings & rich exposed beams bring warm natural character to the main living spaces. The showpiece living room features a fireplace w/ textured stone-look surround, walls of glass framing the tree canopy, & two sets of sliding doors to an expansive deck ideal for alfresco dining & lounging. The kitchen offers soft gray Shaker-style cabinetry, natural stone counters, artisan tile backsplash, five-burner gas range, stainless chimney hood, dishwasher, fridge, & a U-shaped layout w/ generous storage. It opens to the dining room for easy entertaining. A flexible den, 3 bedrooms, & 2 updated baths complete the main residence. The ADU includes an open great room w/ deck access, 2 bedrooms, updated bath, & updated kitchen, ideal for guests, a home office, or potential rental income. Additional features include an attached garage, double-pane windows, multi-zone forced-air heat, energy-efficient upgrades, & a private backyard w/ multiple decks. One block from public transportation, close to great hiking & biking trails, & just minutes from Montclair Village & Hwy 13 for easy access to both SF & Walnut Creek.

verdict: A canopy-immersed 1977 post-and-beam treehouse with a genuine 2BR ADU at $361/sf — you trade bay views and yard for privacy, character, and income/guest flexibility. The main house is bright and updated where it counts (kitchen, baths, glass-walled living room), the deck life is real, and the price sits 35% under its own 2020 close. The catches are structural: Very High FHSZ with eucalyptus hard against the decks, steep mostly-unusable land, and stairs everywhere. For a solo technical buyer who works from home and wants a guest/rental wing, this is the strongest value-per-square-foot seen on this ridge.
